INSERT INTO installation_deletion_receipts
(installation_id, token_hash, expires_at)
VALUES (?, ?, unixepoch() + 604800)
ON CONFLICT(installation_id) DO UPDATE SET
token_hash = excluded.token_hash, expires_at = excluded.expires_at

DELETE FROM reminder_delivery_log WHERE subscription_id IN
(SELECT id FROM push_subscriptions WHERE installation_id = ?)

DELETE FROM birthday_delivery_log WHERE subscription_id IN
(SELECT id FROM push_subscriptions WHERE installation_id = ?)

DELETE FROM reminder_settings WHERE subscription_id IN
(SELECT id FROM push_subscriptions WHERE installation_id = ?)
